protected_surface: every acquired row, not a fixed tail
reason: compute_indicators copies the frame and runs rolling and ewm calculations over the whole series. ATR uses the previous close. A change to any earlier OHLC value can change the last indicator row.
indicator_windows: scaled from lookback and the full bar count; MACD ewm starts at the first row
price_basis: mid OHLC is the trading frame; bid and ask buckets are retained on the same rows
incomplete_candles: dropped before the frame exists; the remaining complete flag is sealed
order_quote: separate fresh pricing snapshot; bid for SELL and ask for BUY; not the M5 close
external_features_on_live_entry_path: none identified beyond the acquired candle frame and the separate order quote
management_prices: cached bid/ask closeout quotes, independent of the candle seal
